{{Combat}} [[Northdale]] | affiliation = [[Scourge]], [[Scarlet Crusade]], [[Argent Dawn]] | loc = Northern [[Lordaeron]] }} The '''Plaguelands''', also referred to as the '''Plagues'''{{Alliance}} [60G] [[Flint Shadowmore (quest)|Flint Shadowmore]], and sometimes including all of the [[Northlands]] (that is globally composed by the northern regions of [[Lordaeron]]), are the regions that were most corrupted by the [[Scourge]] during the [[Third War]]. ==Geography== The proper Plaguelands are the [[Western Plaguelands|Western]] and [[Eastern Plaguelands]], including the [[Scarlet Enclave]]. ===Maps and subregions=== [[File:WorldMap-WesternPlaguelands.jpg|thumb|left|Map of the Western Plaguelands.]] [[File:WorldMap-EasternPlaguelands.jpg|thumb|left|Map of the Eastern Plaguelands.]] [[File:WorldMap-Scarlet.jpg|thumb|left|Map of the Scarlet Enclave.]] {| class="fandom-table" |- ||'''[[Western Plaguelands]]'''
